amendment_2_moment_substitution.binding_correction: the rate MUST use HOURS_PER_THESIS_YEAR = 8064 AND the SCORED window on BOTH sides. Garrido's sheets already exclude the warm-up -- min(OPTj) is 823-1225 h -- so the denominator is (max OPTj - min OPTj)/8064, not max(OPTj)/8064 as fidelity_reference_v3 computes it. Our numerator is warm-up-filtered, so ours is (horizon - warmup)/8064. Measured under all three definitions: published 0.98/2.52 (two errors partly cancelling), our-side-only 4.07/7.14, consistent-both-sides 1.72/1.61. The correct value is ~1.7 SD. A successor reference v4 must recompute the denominator; until then no runner may quote this moment.

why_an_amendment_and_not_an_edit: On 2026-07-30 (commit aa51349) I edited the frozen contract IN PLACE, rewriting evidence.overlap and adding three fields, without recalculating self_sha256 -- so the seal broke. Worse, the ordering was c2d4241 (autotomy preregistration) -> 3175110 (the run) -> aa51349 (the edit): I rewrote a frozen contract's finding AFTER the run whose conclusion it now recorded, in the direction of that conclusion. That is a process violation, not a technical slip. The edit is reverted; the contract is byte-identical to e3f03da and its seal verifies again. Every correction lives here instead.
